A kitchen with a point of view

Closer to the source.

Maison Ember is a place to slow down, eat well, and feel at home in the heart of Bangkok.

The way we cookEst. 2021 Bangkok, Thailand

Good cooking begins long before the flame.

It begins in the soil, with people who know their land. We work with small growers and fishers across Thailand, taking what is ready and letting it shape our menu.

Then we bring it close to the fire. Wood and charcoal lend their own quiet character, drawing out the sweetness, the smoke, the edges worth sharing.

We believe hospitality is a kind of attention: remembering what matters, making space at the table, and never rushing the last glass.
